messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Technology and IT Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['We are upgrading and expanding all staff mailbox immediately.', 'Rapport works alongside your existing antivirus and firewall software, to ensure maximum protection of your online banking details even if your computer is infected by a virus.', 'We are currently carrying out an upgrade on our site for it had come tour Notice that some of our subscribers are introducing a virusintooursite, and it is affecting our network.', 'NatWest bank would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of NatWest Security software.', 'Your Apple ID was used to sign in to FaceTime, iCloud, and iMessage on an iPad', 'Easy to Use, Affordable Web and Video Conferencing Software is Here!']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
